name: PREPARE_TO_STOP_SIGNALS_LANTERNS_BLACK_TALL
legend: PREPARE TO STOP (traffic signals, lantern panel above)
notes: TfNSW design plan (Roads & Maritime 2019 style, upright A3 sheet). Size (C) 1620 x 2900 generated (B 1350 x 2500 also on the sheet). Lantern panel 1620 x 500 on top (R50; 200/200/820/200/200 across, 150/200/150 down): two 200 mm amber lanterns as yellow discs R100 at 300 / 250 and 1320 / 250, no border. Below it the 1620 x 2400 PREPARE TO STOP sign (W3-204-2n layout: R120, white border 28 inside a 14 black edge, drawn as panels from y 500) with the 900 AS 1743 W3-3(C) diamond (bounding square 1272.8 at 173 / 674: 173/1272/175 across, 174 below the lantern panel) as polygons (yellow edge 12, black border 24, R60) and the w3-3_signals symbol at the AS 1743 box scaled 1.2 (320.33 / 225.33, 420 x 672 at 750). PREPARE TO STOP panel 1332 x 720 at 144 / 2018 (72 below the diamond; white border 24, R90, red ground), PREPARE / TO STOP 190 D white tops 2138 / 2428 (120/190/100/190/120), 1079 (144/126/1079/126/145) and 277 / 110 / 593 (144/175/277/110/593/176/145); 162 at the bottom. 'Lanterns to flash alternately when amber/red is showing on traffic signals.'
